offline.note: H0-H22 are deterministic offline contract scenarios; the schema test and the prior Capture/Diff/Intent tests are included in the npm total.

intentional_violations: C1 moved 500 mil, exceeding the R1/C1 3 mm center-distance limit
live_fail.note: The assertion engine only evaluated JSON captures; all EasyEDA mutations were performed by the separate live-demo harness through documented APIs.

restoration.canonicalization_observation: A first pad-net-only restoration read produced a pad rotation facet mismatch while semantic diff stayed zero; restoring the documented pad rotation value (90 degrees in modify, radians in getter) returned all facet hashes and snapshot_hash to baseline.

capability_boundary.source_detail: pads_derived when PCB net names have no native members
unsupported_or_unverified: arcs as a non-empty assertion fixture
capability_boundary.policy: Unknown, unsupported, and ambiguous evidence is UNVERIFIABLE; it is never silently converted to PASS or FAIL.

criteria.summary: Versioned edaguard.assertions.v1 source schema is present.
Versioned edaguard.assertion-result.v1 result schema is present.
Only a valid_snapshot=true capture envelope is evaluated; invalid input aborts.
Selectors compile against the target snapshot and bind project/document identity.
Every rule returns PASS, FAIL, or UNVERIFIABLE with expected/actual/reason/evidence.
strict=true blocks FAIL and UNVERIFIABLE; strict=false only relaxes UNVERIFIABLE.
Component existence and count assertions are implemented.
LCSC validity, footprint, and BOM-field assertions are implemented.
Preferred-source net and pin assertions use native or conservative pad-derived membership only.
Integer-nanometre center distance and reliable board-edge assertions are implemented.
Unsupported, missing, incomplete, and ambiguous evidence is surfaced as UNVERIFIABLE.
Repeated assertion runs are byte-stable and contain no runtime/timestamp fields.
assert compile/run and test provide JSON and human-readable output with stable exit codes.
All H0-H22 offline acceptance scenarios pass.
Independent EasyEDA test-board capture produced 8/8 PASS.
Independent EasyEDA intentional LCSC, pin, and distance violations produced 3 FAIL without false PASS.
Assertion compile/run code has no EasyEDA, MCP, Bridge, save, rollback, or repair path.
Final capture exactly matches the original hash/facets and semantic diff is zero.
